main_design.paired_unit: context; root is the clustering unit

FULL_TASK_SR.definition: Mean frozen geometric full_task_success_y across all48 prespecified contexts per method
FULL_TASK_SR.unknown_policy: Unknown/corrupt/incomplete evidence blocks final table; never silently drop rows or substitute success/failure

LIFT_SR.definition: Mean observed lift>=0.03m above post-probe object height, same48 contexts

DROP_RATE.definition: Mean of native object-drop terminal OR independently proven persistent pre-release detached-and-fallen event outside target
DROP_RATE.label_preservation: Does not silently replace the frozen geometric full-task label; any recovered-drop success is explicitly disclosed

MEAN_SELECTED_SETPOINT.definition: Unweighted mean of selected scalar grip-force setpoint over48 contexts

MEASURED_BILATERAL_SQUEEZE.per_timestep: 2 * min(actual left normal force, actual right normal force)
MEASURED_BILATERAL_SQUEEZE.primary_aggregation: Mean per-branch non-release commanded-grasp squeeze, then equal-weight mean across48 contexts
MEASURED_BILATERAL_SQUEEZE.required_companion: BILATERAL_CONTACT_CONDITIONAL_SQUEEZE: same branch-balanced mean restricted to both observed normal forces>=0.15N; report qualifying timestep counts and missing branches

FORCE_SAVING_VS_FIXED5.primary_basis: selected setpoint, never zero force after a drop
FORCE_SAVING_VS_FIXED5.measured_companion: Report separately with explicit contact/time denominator; do not substitute it for primary saving

uncertainty.paired_comparison: Keep methods paired by context and sampling seed; do not treat192 branches as192 independent environments
uncertainty.generalization_limit: Four fresh root groups; avoid strong population-wide or asymptotic significance claims

evidence_requirements: Every downstream arm action joins to online inference receipt
Same postprobe state and initial observation/chunk per context
Matched policy noise seeds across methods
No scripted or replay rollout in final table
